response.rationale: Both forms naturally mean backache. Indonesian commonly uses “sakit punggung,” while Malaysian Malay commonly uses “sakit belakang,” making this a useful everyday vocabulary contrast.
response.risk_rationale: “Sakit pinggang” may also be used colloquially for some back pain, but it is not the clearest equivalent for general backache.
response.shared_synonym_rationale: No relevant shared synonym undermines this contrast; “sakit pinggang” commonly narrows toward waist or lower-back pain.
